full_judgment: 6. The record shows that the opposite party claimed title to the suit land on the basis of an auction purchase by the opposite party No. 1 for the share of Mohir Sheikh. Mohir Sheikh inherited half of the suit jote and his share was 2.262 decimals land. Share of Iman Sheikh has not been auction-sold. The opposite party took pat-tan of the land from the suit khatian from the auction purchaser and the petitioner purchased the share of Iman Sheikh and from disinterested heirs of Mohir Sheikh. The opposite party has claimed the share of Monir Sheikh. So, since the holding has not been partitioned amongst the co-sharer and both the parties are co-sharer of the suit properties and the permanent injunction suit generally cannot lie in such a holding as the petitioner filed the suit for injunction against co-sharer with a misconceived idea and the court decided the title of the suit property against him. In order to the decision the learned Advocate for the petitioner filed a petition for amendment of the plaint of the partition suit praying for declaration of title of the petitioner to the suit land.
